subject: 英聽
title: AI-4 英語（聽力）模擬卷（會考水準）
note: 由 AI 依心測中心英語聽力架構（辨識句意 3 題、基本問答 8 題、言談理解 10 題，三選一）編寫，非會考真題；難度比照近年會考（平均約 2.5 級）：對話與廣播長度和會考相當，含計畫改變、言外之意、慣用語、簡單金額計算，誘答選項多用錄音中出現過的字詞或別的細節。第一部分的圖片由程式繪製（tools/ai_sets/ai4_listening.py），語音以錄音稿合成（非會考原音）。
topics: Netflix 動畫電影 KPop Demon Hunters（2025/6 上線）成為 Netflix 史上觀看次數最多的電影：https://www.koreajoongangdaily.com/entertainment/kpop-demon-hunters-becomes-most-watched-film-on-netflix-with-236-million-views/12114967
主題曲 "Golden"（HUNTR/X）2025 年登上 Billboard Hot 100 第一名，2026/2/1 獲葛萊美最佳影視歌曲獎，為第一首得到葛萊美獎的 K-pop 歌曲：https://au.variety.com/2026/music/global/kpop-demons-hunters-grammy-win-32586/

撐竿跳 Armand Duplantis 2025/9/15 在東京世界田徑錦標賽跳過 6.30 公尺，第 14 次刷新世界紀錄並衛冕：https://www.news4jax.com/sports/2025/09/15/duplantis-breaks-pole-vault-world-record-for-14th-time-to-capture-third-world-championship-title/
Labubu 熱潮（2025）：香港藝術家龍家昇（Kasing Lung）創作，泡泡瑪特（Pop Mart）以盲盒販售，打開才知道是哪一款，各地排隊搶購：https://www.nbcnews.com/pop-culture/pop-culture-news/labubu-craze-viral-lines-pop-mart-stores-rcna203213
2026 台灣燈會在嘉義（3/3–3/15），2026 為馬年，但主燈「光沐－世界的阿里山」以阿里山神木為意象、高約 21 公尺、每半小時展演；馬年元素在小提燈「喔熊馬抵嘉」（熊騎木馬）：https://www.ctee.com.tw/news/20260109701141-430104
2026 年農曆新年為 2/17，進入馬年：https://www.canada.ca/en/department-national-defence/maple-leaf/defence/2026/02/year-horse-lunar-new-year-2026.html
對話中的人物、班級出遊、診所留言、電影票價、捷運公園站／湖站與河濱自行車道新聞皆為虛構情境

items.explanation:
【聽力稿】There are three apples and two bananas on the plate.
【中譯】盤子上有三顆蘋果和兩根香蕉。
【解析】要同時符合「三顆蘋果」和「兩根香蕉」。(B) 三顆蘋果、兩根香蕉，完全符合；(A) 兩顆蘋果、三根香蕉，數量剛好顛倒；(C) 蘋果是三顆，但香蕉有三根。故選 (B)。
transcript: There are three apples and two bananas on the plate.

items.explanation:
【聽力稿】The cat is sleeping on the chair, and the ball is under the table.
【中譯】貓在椅子上睡覺，球在桌子底下。
【解析】要同時符合兩個位置：貓「在椅子上」（on the chair），球「在桌子下」（under the table）。(C) 貓睡在椅子上、球在桌子底下；(A) 貓和球的位置顛倒了，貓在桌子底下、球在椅子上；(B) 貓雖然在椅子上，但球在桌子「上面」，不是桌子底下。故選 (C)。
transcript: The cat is sleeping on the chair, and the ball is under the table.

items.explanation:
【聽力稿】The museum is closed on Mondays, and on Saturdays, it closes early, at four o'clock.
【中譯】博物館星期一休館，星期六比較早關門，四點就關。
【解析】兩個條件：星期一休館（closed on Mondays）；星期六提早在四點關門，其他開館日是五點關。(A) 星期一 Closed，星期六 9 a.m.–4 p.m.，其他日子到 5 p.m.，完全符合；(B) 星期一休館沒錯，但四點關門的是星期二到五，星期六反而開到五點；(C) 星期六四點關門沒錯，但休館的是星期日，星期一有開。故選 (A)。
transcript: The museum is closed on Mondays, and on Saturdays, it closes early, at four o'clock.

options: For about an hour.
At four thirty.
At my teacher's house.
items.explanation:
【聽力稿】What time does your piano lesson start?
【中譯】你的鋼琴課幾點開始？
【解析】What time 問「幾點」，要回答時間點。(B)「四點半」正確。(A) 回答「上多久」（How long 的答案）；(C) 回答「在哪裡上」（Where 的答案）。故選 (B)。
transcript: What time does your piano lesson start?

options: Sorry. I didn't know it was so loud.
Sure. Which channel do you want to watch?
Yes, I studied for the test last night.
items.explanation:
【聽力稿】Could you turn down the TV a little? I'm trying to study.
【中譯】你可以把電視（音量）關小聲一點嗎？我正在讀書。
【解析】turn down 是「把音量調小」，對方在讀書，嫌電視太吵。(A)「抱歉，我不知道這麼大聲」適當回應。(B) 對方是要讀書，不是要看電視、選頻道；(C) 用了聽到的 study，說的卻是自己昨晚讀書，答非所問。故選 (A)。
transcript: Could you turn down the TV a little? I'm trying to study.

options: No, I've never been to Korea.
Yes, they're talking too loudly.
Yes, twice. The songs are great.
items.explanation:
【聽力稿】Have you seen KPop Demon Hunters yet? Everyone in my class is talking about it.
【中譯】你看過《KPop 獵魔女團》（KPop Demon Hunters）了嗎？我們班上每個人都在討論它。
【解析】對方問你「有沒有看過」這部片。(C)「看過兩次了，歌很好聽」回答了有看過。(A) 只抓到 KPop 聯想到韓國，說的是沒去過韓國，答非所問；(B) 用了聽到的 talking，說的卻是別人講話太大聲。（KPop Demon Hunters 是 2025 年 6 月在 Netflix 上線的動畫電影，成為 Netflix 史上觀看次數最多的電影，主題曲〈Golden〉登上美國 Billboard 單曲榜第一名，並在 2026 年 2 月得到葛萊美獎。）故選 (C)。
transcript: Have you seen KPop Demon Hunters yet? Everyone in my class is talking about it.

options: Yes. Could you get me a bottle of milk?
Yes, it's open twenty-four hours a day.
Sorry, it's not convenient for me today.
items.explanation:
【聽力稿】I'm going to the convenience store. Do you need anything?
【中譯】我要去便利商店，你需要什麼東西嗎？
【解析】對方問你要不要幫你買東西。(A)「要，可以幫我買一瓶牛奶嗎？」回答了需要什麼。(B) 說的是商店的營業時間，沒有回答需不需要東西；(C) 用了和 convenience 很像的 convenient（方便的），答非所問。故選 (A)。
transcript: I'm going to the convenience store. Do you need anything?

options: No, I'm usually late for school.
Sure. Let's stay up and study together.
Yes. I watched a baseball game until midnight.
items.explanation:
【聽力稿】You look tired. Did you stay up late again last night?
【中譯】你看起來很累。你昨晚又熬夜了嗎？
【解析】stay up late 是「熬夜」。(C)「對，我看棒球比賽看到半夜」說明了熬夜的原因。(A) 用了聽到的 late，說的卻是上學常遲到，答非所問；(B) 對方問的是昨晚的事，這句卻是邀對方一起熬夜讀書。故選 (C)。
transcript: You look tired. Did you stay up late again last night?

options: Yes, I can see the words clearly now.
Aren't they on your head?
They look really nice on you.
items.explanation:
【聽力稿】I can't find my glasses anywhere. Have you seen them?
【中譯】我到處都找不到我的眼鏡，你有看到嗎？
【解析】(B)「不就在你頭上嗎？」用反問句告訴對方眼鏡在哪裡，是很自然的回應。(A) 說的是自己現在看得很清楚，跟幫對方找眼鏡無關；(C) 對方正找不到眼鏡、沒有戴著，稱讚「戴起來很好看」不合理。故選 (B)。
transcript: I can't find my glasses anywhere. Have you seen them?

options: That's OK. The movie hasn't started yet.
Great. You should take the bus more often.
Don't worry. I'll be there in thirty minutes.
items.explanation:
【聽力稿】I'm sorry I'm late. The bus didn't come for thirty minutes.
【中譯】抱歉我遲到了。公車三十分鐘都沒來。
【解析】對方為遲到道歉。(A)「沒關係，電影還沒開始」接受了道歉。(B) 公車害對方遲到，卻說「太好了，你應該多搭公車」，不合理；(C) 對方已經到了，你卻說自己三十分鐘後才到，用了聽到的 thirty minutes 卻答非所問。故選 (A)。
transcript: I'm sorry I'm late. The bus didn't come for thirty minutes.

options: Amazing! I can't even imagine jumping that high.
Oh no! Is he badly hurt?
How many meters did he swim?
items.explanation:
【聽力稿】Duplantis broke the pole vault world record again in Tokyo. He jumped six point three meters!
【中譯】Duplantis（杜普蘭提斯）在東京又打破了撐竿跳世界紀錄，他跳過了 6.3 公尺！
【解析】break a record 是「打破紀錄」，是好消息。(A)「太厲害了！我連想像跳那麼高都沒辦法」適當回應。(B) 把 broke 誤解成「摔斷（骨頭）」，以為他受傷了；(C) 撐竿跳是「跳」的項目，對方說的是 jumped，不是游泳。（2025 年 9 月 15 日，瑞典的 Armand Duplantis 在東京世界田徑錦標賽跳過 6.30 公尺，第 14 次刷新撐竿跳世界紀錄。）故選 (A)。
transcript: Duplantis broke the pole vault world record again in Tokyo. He jumped six point three meters!

options: To the zoo.
To the school gym.
To the science museum.
items.explanation:
【聽力稿】M: Hi, everyone. Ms. Chen just told me about tomorrow's class trip. We'll meet at the school gate at eight. If it's sunny, we'll go to the zoo as planned. If it rains, we won't stay in the school gym like last time. We'll go to the science museum instead. Either way, please bring your own lunch and a water bottle.
Question: Where will the class go if it rains tomorrow?
【中譯】嗨，各位。陳老師剛剛告訴我明天班級出遊的事。我們八點在校門口集合。如果天氣晴朗，就照原定計畫去動物園。如果下雨，我們不會像上次一樣待在學校體育館，而是改去科學博物館。不管去哪裡，都請自己帶午餐和水壺。問題：如果明天下雨，全班會去哪裡？
【解析】男生說下雨時「改去科學博物館」（We'll go to the science museum instead）。(A) 動物園是晴天時的計畫；(B) 待在體育館是「上次」的做法，這次說了不會（won't）待在體育館。故選 (C)。
transcript: Hi, everyone. Ms. Chen just told me about tomorrow's class trip. We'll meet at the school gate at eight. If it's sunny, we'll go to the zoo as planned. If it rains, we won't stay in the school gym like last time. We'll go to the science museum instead. Either way, please bring your own lunch and a water bottle.
Where will the class go if it rains tomorrow?

options: Wait in line again to buy another blind box.
Trade one of her green Labubus for one of Amy's pink ones.
Give the pink Labubu to the boy.
items.explanation:
【聽力稿】W: Look! I finally got a Labubu. I waited in line for two hours this morning.
M: That little monster toy? Why is everyone so crazy about it?
W: It's cute, and it comes in a blind box. You don't know which one you'll get until you open it.
M: So which one did you want?
W: The pink one. But I got the green one again. Now I have two green ones.
M: Didn't your friend Amy say she wanted a green one? And she has two pink ones, right?
W: You're right! I'll call her right now.
Question: What will the girl most likely do?
【中譯】女：你看！我終於買到 Labubu 了，我今天早上排了兩個小時的隊。男：那個小怪獸玩偶？為什麼大家都那麼瘋它？女：它很可愛，而且是裝在盲盒裡賣的，不打開就不知道會拿到哪一款。男：那妳想要哪一款？女：粉紅色的。可是我又拿到綠色的了，現在我有兩個綠色的。男：妳朋友 Amy 不是說她想要綠色的嗎？而且她有兩個粉紅色的，對吧？女：對耶！我現在就打電話給她。問題：女孩最可能會做什麼？
【解析】女孩多了一個綠色的、想要粉紅色的；Amy 想要綠色的、多了一個粉紅色的。男孩一提醒，女孩就說要馬上打給 Amy，可見她要用多的綠色 Labubu 跟 Amy 交換粉紅色的。(A) 排隊兩小時是她今天早上做過的事，她並沒有說要再去排隊；(C) 她根本還沒有粉紅色的，也沒有說要送男孩東西。（Labubu 是香港藝術家龍家昇創作、泡泡瑪特以盲盒販售的玩偶，2025 年在各地掀起排隊搶購熱潮。）故選 (B)。
transcript: Look! I finally got a Labubu. I waited in line for two hours this morning.
That little monster toy? Why is everyone so crazy about it?
It's cute, and it comes in a blind box. You don't know which one you'll get until you open it.
So which one did you want?
The pink one. But I got the green one again. Now I have two green ones.
Didn't your friend Amy say she wanted a green one? And she has two pink ones, right?
You're right! I'll call her right now.
What will the girl most likely do?

options: A tall tree.
A horse.
A bear riding a horse.
items.explanation:
【聽力稿】W: Did you go to the Taiwan Lantern Festival in Chiayi in March 2026?
M: Yes, I went with my family on the last weekend. It was really crowded.
W: Was the main lantern a horse? Twenty twenty-six is the Year of the Horse.
M: That's what I thought, too. But it wasn't. It looked like a giant tree from Alishan, about twenty meters tall.
W: A tree? How interesting!
M: Every half hour, it had a light show. The horse was on the small hand lanterns. They looked like a bear riding a wooden horse.
Question: What did the main lantern look like?
【中譯】女：你 2026 年三月有去嘉義的台灣燈會嗎？男：有，我最後一個週末跟家人去的，人超多。女：主燈是馬嗎？2026 年是馬年。男：我本來也這麼以為，但不是。它看起來像一棵阿里山的巨大神木，大約二十公尺高。女：一棵樹？真有趣！男：每半小時它會有一場燈光秀。馬出現在小提燈上，小提燈是一隻熊騎著木馬的樣子。問題：主燈看起來是什麼樣子？
【解析】男子說主燈「不是馬」，而是「看起來像一棵阿里山的巨大神木」。(B) 馬是女子的猜測，男子說「但不是」；(C) 熊騎木馬是「小提燈」的樣子，不是主燈。（2026 年 2 月 17 日起是馬年；2026 台灣燈會 3 月 3 日至 15 日在嘉義舉行，主燈「光沐－世界的阿里山」以阿里山神木為意象，高約 21 公尺。）故選 (A)。
transcript: Did you go to the Taiwan Lantern Festival in Chiayi in March 2026?
Yes, I went with my family on the last weekend. It was really crowded.
Was the main lantern a horse? Twenty twenty-six is the Year of the Horse.
That's what I thought, too. But it wasn't. It looked like a giant tree from Alishan, about twenty meters tall.
Every half hour, it had a light show. The horse was on the small hand lanterns. They looked like a bear riding a wooden horse.
What did the main lantern look like?

options: On Friday at four thirty.
On Thursday at four thirty.
On Wednesday at four thirty.
items.explanation:
【聽力稿】W: Hello, this is Doctor Lin's office calling for Kevin Wang. Your appointment is on Thursday at four thirty. But Doctor Lin has to go to a meeting at the hospital on Thursday afternoon. Can you come on Friday at the same time instead? If Friday is not good for you, please call us back before Wednesday, and we'll find another time for you. Thank you.
Question: When does the woman ask Kevin to come?
【中譯】您好，這裡是林醫師診所，找王凱文。您原本預約的是星期四四點半，但林醫師星期四下午要去醫院開會。您可以改成星期五同一個時間來嗎？如果星期五不方便，請在星期三以前回電，我們會幫您另外找時間。謝謝。問題：這位女士請凱文什麼時候來？
【解析】原本是星期四四點半，因為醫師要開會，改成「星期五同一個時間」（Friday at the same time），也就是星期五四點半。(B) 星期四是原本的預約時間，醫師那天下午不在；(C) 星期三是「回電」的期限，不是看診的日子。故選 (A)。
transcript: Hello, this is Doctor Lin's office calling for Kevin Wang. Your appointment is on Thursday at four thirty. But Doctor Lin has to go to a meeting at the hospital on Thursday afternoon. Can you come on Friday at the same time instead? If Friday is not good for you, please call us back before Wednesday, and we'll find another time for you. Thank you.
When does the woman ask Kevin to come?

options: He likes it as much as he did at first.
He hopes it will win a Grammy.
He is tired of hearing it.
items.explanation:
【聽力稿】M: Can you please stop singing that song? You've been singing it all morning.
W: You mean Golden? I can't help it. It's the song from KPop Demon Hunters.
M: I know. I've watched the movie with you three times. At first, I loved the song, too.
W: It even won a Grammy in February 2026. It was the first K-pop song to win one!
M: Good for them. But if I hear it one more time today, I'm going to wear earplugs.
Question: How does the man feel about the song now?
【中譯】男：妳可以不要再唱那首歌了嗎？妳已經唱了一整個早上。女：你是說〈Golden〉？我忍不住嘛，它是《KPop 獵魔女團》的歌。男：我知道，我已經陪妳看了三次那部電影。一開始我也很喜歡那首歌。女：它 2026 年二月還得了葛萊美獎，是第一首得獎的 K-pop 歌曲！男：恭喜他們。但如果今天再讓我聽到一次，我就要戴耳塞了。問題：男子現在對這首歌有什麼感覺？
【解析】男子請女子別再唱，還說再聽到一次就要戴耳塞，可見他現在已經聽膩了。(A) 他只是「一開始」很喜歡，現在不是；(B) 女子說這首歌「已經」在 2026 年二月得到葛萊美獎，不是還希望它得獎。（〈Golden〉於 2026 年 2 月 1 日獲葛萊美最佳影視歌曲獎，是第一首得到葛萊美獎的 K-pop 歌曲。）故選 (C)。
transcript: Can you please stop singing that song? You've been singing it all morning.
You mean Golden? I can't help it. It's the song from KPop Demon Hunters.
I know. I've watched the movie with you three times. At first, I loved the song, too.
It even won a Grammy in February 2026. It was the first K-pop song to win one!
Good for them. But if I hear it one more time today, I'm going to wear earplugs.
How does the man feel about the song now?

options: 800 dollars.
900 dollars.
850 dollars.
items.explanation:
【聽力稿】W: Three tickets for the seven o'clock show, please. One for me, one for my brother, and one for my mom.
M: Tickets are three hundred dollars each, and students get fifty dollars off. Are you and your brother students?
W: Yes. Here is my student card. Oh no, my brother left his card at home. Is that OK?
M: I'm sorry. Without a student card, I can't give him the student price.
W: I see. That's fine.
Question: How much will the woman pay for the three tickets?
【中譯】女：請給我七點那場的三張票，我一張、我弟弟一張、我媽媽一張。男：票一張三百元，學生折五十元。妳和妳弟弟是學生嗎？女：是的，這是我的學生證。喔不，我弟弟把學生證忘在家裡了，這樣可以嗎？男：很抱歉，沒有學生證，我不能算他學生價。女：我知道了，沒關係。問題：女子三張票要付多少錢？
【解析】只有女子出示學生證，可以折五十元：300－50＝250 元；弟弟沒帶學生證、媽媽不是學生，各 300 元。合計 250＋300＋300＝850 元。(A) 800 元是把弟弟也算成學生價，但他沒帶學生證；(B) 900 元是三張都沒有折扣，忘了女子有學生證。故選 (C)。

options: His mouth hurts, so he can't eat any cake.
He won't tell anyone about the party.
He will tell Dad about the party the day before.
items.explanation:
【聽力稿】W: I'm planning a surprise party for Mom's fiftieth birthday next Sunday.
M: That's a great idea! Does Dad know about it?
W: Not yet. You know Dad. He can never keep a secret. I'll tell him the day before the party.
M: Smart. And don't worry about me. My lips are sealed.
W: Thanks. Can you help me pick up the cake on Sunday morning?
M: Sure, no problem.
Question: What does the man mean when he says "My lips are sealed"?
【中譯】女：我正在計畫下星期天幫媽媽辦五十歲生日的驚喜派對。男：好主意！爸爸知道嗎？女：還不知道。你也知道爸爸，他從來守不住秘密。我會在派對前一天才告訴他。男：聰明。還有，妳不用擔心我，我的嘴巴是封起來的。女：謝謝。你可以星期天早上幫我去拿蛋糕嗎？男：當然，沒問題。問題：男子說 "My lips are sealed" 是什麼意思？
【解析】前面在談「守不住秘密」的爸爸，男子接著說「不用擔心我，我的嘴巴是封起來的」，意思是他會守住秘密、不會說出去。(A) 只照字面理解成嘴巴有問題，而且他還答應去拿蛋糕；(C) 派對前一天告訴爸爸的是「女子」的計畫，不是男子要做的事。故選 (B)。

options: Take the Blue Line to Park Station as usual.
Get off at Lake Station and take the free bus.
Wait for the free bus at Exit Two of Park Station.
items.explanation:
【聽力稿】Attention, please. This Saturday, from ten in the morning to four in the afternoon, Blue Line trains will not stop at Park Station because of repair work. Riders going to Park Station can get off at Lake Station, one stop before Park Station, and take a free bus from Exit Two. The bus leaves every ten minutes. After four o'clock, trains will stop at Park Station as usual. Thank you.
Question: Mia wants to go to Park Station at eleven on Saturday morning. What should she do?
【中譯】請注意。本星期六上午十點到下午四點，因為維修工程，藍線列車不停靠公園站。要到公園站的旅客，可以在公園站前一站的湖站下車，從二號出口搭免費公車，公車每十分鐘一班。四點以後，列車照常停靠公園站。謝謝。問題：Mia 星期六早上十一點要去公園站，她應該怎麼做？
【解析】十一點在「十點到四點」之間，列車不停公園站，所以要在前一站湖站下車，從二號出口搭免費公車。(A) 照常搭到公園站是四點以後才可以；(C) 免費公車是從「湖站」的二號出口出發，不是公園站。故選 (B)。

options: A new watch.
A book.
A photo album.
items.explanation:
【聽力稿】M: Grandpa's birthday is this Friday. What should we give him?
W: How about a new watch? His old one is broken.
M: Mom already bought him one last week.
W: Oh. Then what about a book? He loves reading.
M: His eyes aren't very good these days. He can't read for long.
W: Hmm. He always says he misses the old days. Why don't we make him a photo album of our family?
M: Great idea. I'll look for the old photos tonight.
Question: What will they give Grandpa?
【中譯】男：爺爺的生日是這個星期五，我們要送他什麼？女：送一支新手錶如何？他的舊手錶壞了。男：媽媽上星期已經買一支給他了。女：喔，那送一本書呢？他很愛看書。男：他最近眼睛不太好，沒辦法看太久。女：嗯……他常說很懷念以前的日子。我們何不做一本全家人的相簿送他？男：好主意，我今晚就去找舊照片。問題：他們要送爺爺什麼？
【解析】手錶和書都被男生否決了，最後兩人同意做一本家庭相簿，男生還說今晚就去找舊照片。(A) 媽媽上星期已經買了手錶給爺爺；(B) 爺爺最近眼睛不好，不能看書太久。故選 (C)。

options: They think it costs too much money.
They think it is a good plan.
They think only people who ride bikes will like it.
items.explanation:
【聽力稿】Good evening. Next on the news, River City will build a new bike path along the river. It will open next spring. Let's hear what people think.
M: I ride my bike to work every day. Right now, I have to ride next to cars and buses. The new path will make my trip much safer.
W: Some people say it costs too much money. But I think it's worth it. My kids can finally ride their bikes on weekends, and I won't need to worry.
M: I don't even have a bike, but I walk my dog by the river every morning. A nicer riverside is good news for everyone.
Question: What do these three people think of the new bike path?
【中譯】晚安。下一則新聞，河城（虛構城市）將沿著河邊興建一條新的自行車道，明年春天啟用。我們來聽聽民眾怎麼說。男一：我每天騎腳踏車上班，現在得在汽車和公車旁邊騎，新車道會讓我通勤安全很多。女：有人說花太多錢了，但我覺得很值得。我的孩子週末終於可以騎腳踏車，我也不用擔心了。男二：我連腳踏車都沒有，但我每天早上都在河邊遛狗。河邊變得更好，對每個人都是好消息。問題：這三個人對新的自行車道有什麼看法？
【解析】三個人都支持：第一位覺得通勤更安全，第二位覺得值得、孩子可以安心騎車，第三位雖然不騎車也認為是好消息。(A)「花太多錢」是「有些人」的說法，女子接著說 But I think it's worth it，表示她不同意；(C) 第三位沒有腳踏車，卻也覺得是好消息，所以不是只有騎車的人會喜歡。故選 (B)。
